description: This Python script initializes a new skill directory from a template, creating a SKILL.md file and optional resource directories with example files.

methods.name: normalize_skill_name
methods.description: Converts a skill name to lowercase hyphen-case, removing invalid characters.

methods.name: title_case_skill_name
methods.description: Converts a hyphenated skill name to Title Case for display.

methods.name: parse_resources
methods.description: Parses and validates the resources string, returning a list of resource types.

methods.name: create_resource_dirs
methods.description: Creates resource directories and optional example files within the skill directory.

methods.name: init_skill
methods.description: Main function to initialize a new skill directory with template files and resources.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line arguments and calls init_skill.
